result.summary: The food delivery app page renders mostly well, but there are a few minor visual issues related to text truncation and inconsistent styling in the horizontal restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel shows a clearer peek of the next item or add proper text truncation with ellipsis so partial cards look intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards: the Ramen card uses a white circular background while the pizza card uses a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant name and delivery info are partially hidden due to being at the edge of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card spacing or scroll behavior to prevent essential information from being clipped.
